title: Stage 6 — Remediation, Git Recovery, and Regression Validation
summary: All three Stage 5 defects (BUG-1 hashtag array, BUG-2 conversation UUID, BUG-3 Groq startup) plus two additional defects found during Stage 6 regression (like/unlike multi-statement SQL, misleading delete response) are FIXED and VERIFIED with executable proof. A minimal vitest regression suite now runs under pnpm test. Remaining gaps are environmental (no GROQ key, no object-storage sidecar, no live production DB) and are classified CONFIGURATION BLOCKED, not code defects.

defects.fix: Replaced raw-SQL array interpolation (JSON.stringify(tags)::text[]) with typed ORM db.insert(postsTable).values({hashtags: tags}).returning().
defects.proof: 4 smoke cases (no tags, one, multiple, special chars) all return 201 with correct arrays; vitest db-regression covers empty + special-char arrays.

defects.fix: Added UUID_RE validation and ::uuid casts in the conversation-create CTE member insert; duplicate member IDs handled via DISTINCT; invalid UUIDs rejected with 400.
defects.proof: Valid UUID 201, invalid UUID 400 (smoke); vitest db-regression creates a 2-member conversation.

defects.fix: Removed module-load new Groq(...) from social.ts. AI provider is instantiated lazily per request (getGroq()), and all AI handlers guard on process.env.GROQ_API_KEY.
defects.proof: Server boots with no GROQ_API_KEY; /api/ai/chat returns 503, /api/ai/daily-tasks returns [], /api/ai/life-tip returns static fallback. vitest regression imports social route + full app with GROQ_API_KEY unset.

defects.fix: Split multi-statement raw SQL into typed ORM insert/delete with onConflictDoNothing/returning, then a separate counter UPDATE only when a row was actually inserted/removed.
defects.proof: like 200, duplicate-like keeps likes_count at 1, unlike 200, duplicate-unlike keeps count at 0 (smoke).

defects.fix: Return 404 when no owned row was deleted (added RETURNING id + row-count check). Ownership was already enforced at SQL level (WHERE id = X AND user_id = Y); response is now truthful.
defects.proof: Cross-user delete 404, owner delete 200 and row actually removed, nonexistent post 404 (smoke).

suites: src/tests/regression.test.ts (JWT sign/verify/tamper/expiry, bcrypt, GROQ-optional module load, full app import)
src/tests/db-regression.test.ts (hashtag array empty/special-chars, conversation 2-member UUID) — gated on TEST_DATABASE_URL

verification.cors: PRE-EXISTING (cosmetic 500 for disallowed origin; browser still blocks; not a security bypass)
verification.migrations: PASS (62 statements -> 23 public tables on fresh PG16)
verification.typecheck: PASS (libs + api-server + web + scripts, zero errors)
verification.build: PASS (api-server + web; web requires PORT/BASE_PATH which Replit injects)
verification.secret_scan: PASS (no secrets in source; only test fixtures)

git.baseline: grafted HEAD 25cbdf2; Stage 3/4 commits absent from history
git.recovery: Minimized on-disk state committed to arena/01a05271-life-xp (deletions + Stage 4 reconciliation + Stage 6 fixes/tests/docs) without restoring the 2422-file pre-minimization tree
